CREATE TABLE "public"."admission_package_features" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "packageId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."admission_packages" (
  "adultPriceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "badge" text,
  "childPriceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'JMD' NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isFeatured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "maxGuests" int4,
  "minGuests" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "validFrom" timestamptz,
  "validUntil" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookingAdmissionFulfillment" (
  "accessIssuedAt" timestamptz,
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "passesIssuedAt" timestamptz,
  "paymentReference" text,
  "providerEventId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookingPassAccess" (
  "accessCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastAccessedAt" timestamptz,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookingPassAccessSecret" (
  "accessId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "authenticationTag" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "encryptedToken" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "initializationVector" text NOT NULL,
  "keyVersion" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookingPassCredential" (
  "authenticationTag" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "encryptedCredential" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "initializationVector" text NOT NULL,
  "keyVersion" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "passId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookingPassSecurityEvent" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "newVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "passId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "performedById" text,
  "performedByName" text,
  "previousVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_events" (
  "actorId" text,
  "actorType" text,
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_extra_definitions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'JMD' NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "maxQuantity" int4,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "priceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "pricingMode" text DEFAULT 'per_booking' NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_extra_definitions_pricingMode_check_9498960a" CHECK ("pricingMode" IN ('per_booking', 'per_guest'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_extras" (
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "definitionId" uuid,
  "extraDescription" text,
  "extraName" text NOT NULL,
  "extraSlug" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "pricingMode" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "subtotalMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unitPriceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_extras_pricingMode_check_9498960a" CHECK ("pricingMode" IN ('per_booking', 'per_guest'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_guests" (
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "guestType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "subtotalMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unitPriceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_guests_guestType_check_cec0f8ca" CHECK ("guestType" IN ('adult', 'child'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_package_snapshots" (
  "admissionPackageId" uuid,
  "adultQuantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "adultUnitPriceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "childQuantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "childUnitPriceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "packageDescription" text,
  "packageName" text NOT NULL,
  "packageSlug" text NOT NULL,
  "subtotalMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_passes" (
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "firstUsedAt" timestamptz,
  "guestType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "passNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "qrTokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "revokeReason" text,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "sequenceNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "tokenVersion" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "validDate" date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_passes_guestType_check_cec0f8ca" CHECK ("guestType" IN ('adult', 'child')),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_passes_status_check_ed032e1f" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'used', 'revoked', 'cancelled', 'expired'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookings" (
  "admissionSubtotalMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "adultCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "cancellationReason" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "childCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "confirmationSentAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'JMD' NOT NULL,
  "customerEmail" text,
  "customerFirstName" text,
  "customerId" uuid,
  "customerLastName" text,
  "customerPhone" text,
  "discountMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "extrasSubtotalMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "guestCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "paymentStatus" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "taxMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "visitDate" date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bookings_paymentStatus_check_93aac780" CHECK ("paymentStatus" IN ('not_required', 'pending', 'authorized', 'paid', 'failed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded')),
  CONSTRAINT "bookings_status_check_dea2fe8e" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'pending_payment', 'confirmed', 'partially_checked_in', 'checked_in', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'expired', 'refunded'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."check_ins" (
  "bookingId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "checkedInById" text,
  "checkedInByName" text,
  "deviceId" text,
  "gate" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "passId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "scannedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "check_ins_status_check_7067e93e" CHECK ("status" IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'already_used', 'invalid', 'revoked'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."happy_ticket_ledger" (
  "businessKey" text NOT NULL,
  "classId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "orderId" uuid,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "happy_ticket_ledger_type_check_597db84e" CHECK ("type" IN ('order_earn', 'volume_bonus', 'manual_adjustment', 'reward_redemption', 'reversal', 'promotion'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_classes" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "grade" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "teacherDisplayName" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_contacts" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isPrimary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "telephone" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_invoices" (
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'JMD' NOT NULL,
  "deliveryMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "discountMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "dueAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "issuedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "orderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "paidMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'invoiced' NOT NULL,
  "subtotalMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "taxMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "school_invoices_status_check_4486af05" CHECK ("status" IN ('unbilled', 'invoiced', 'due_on_delivery', 'paid', 'partially_paid', 'overdue', 'void'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_order_class_allocations" (
  "classId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "orderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "pizzaBoxes" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_order_lines" (
  "batchSize" int4 NOT NULL,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "orderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productDescription" text,
  "productId" uuid,
  "productName" text NOT NULL,
  "productSlug" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "subtotalMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unitPriceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "school_order_lines_category_check_f344fea7" CHECK ("category" IN ('pizza', 'batch'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_orders" (
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'JMD' NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "deliveredBy" text,
  "deliveryAddress" text NOT NULL,
  "deliveryContactName" text NOT NULL,
  "deliveryInstructions" text,
  "deliveryMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "deliveryNote" text,
  "deliveryTelephone" text NOT NULL,
  "deliveryWindow" text NOT NULL,
  "discountMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text,
  "paymentStatus" text DEFAULT 'unbilled' NOT NULL,
  "paymentTerms" text DEFAULT 'pay_on_delivery' NOT NULL,
  "pizzaFriday" date NOT NULL,
  "recipientName" text,
  "recipientRole" text,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamptz,
  "subtotalMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "taxMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalMinor" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "school_orders_paymentStatus_check_7b9cf2ad" CHECK ("paymentStatus" IN ('unbilled', 'invoiced', 'due_on_delivery', 'paid', 'partially_paid', 'overdue', 'void')),
  CONSTRAINT "school_orders_paymentTerms_check_9822403d" CHECK ("paymentTerms" IN ('pay_on_delivery', 'prepaid', 'net_7', 'net_14', 'account_credit')),
  CONSTRAINT "school_orders_status_check_e612ebae" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready_for_delivery', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'completed', 'change_requested', 'cancelled', 'rejected'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_partners" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "classCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveryInstructions" text,
  "expectedWeeklyParticipation" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "mainTelephone" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "parish" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentTerms" text DEFAULT 'pay_on_delivery' NOT NULL,
  "pizzaPriceOverrideMinor" int4,
  "preferredFrequency" text NOT NULL,
  "principalName" text NOT NULL,
  "schoolEmail" text NOT NULL,
  "schoolType" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "studentPopulation" int4 NOT NULL,
  "suspendedAt" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "school_partners_paymentTerms_check_9822403d" CHECK ("paymentTerms" IN ('pay_on_delivery', 'prepaid', 'net_7', 'net_14', 'account_credit')),
  CONSTRAINT "school_partners_status_check_15b10d9d" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'suspended'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_payments" (
  "amountMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'JMD' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "recordedById" text,
  "recordedByName" text,
  "reference" text,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_products" (
  "batchSize" int4 NOT NULL,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'JMD' NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "priceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "validFrom" timestamptz,
  "validUntil" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "school_products_category_check_f344fea7" CHECK ("category" IN ('pizza', 'batch'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_programme_events" (
  "actorId" text,
  "actorType" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_reward_definitions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "redemptionRules" json,
  "rewardType" text NOT NULL,
  "rewardValue" json,
  "scope" text NOT NULL,
  "ticketThreshold" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "validFrom" timestamptz,
  "validUntil" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "school_reward_definitions_scope_check_2c8ff566" CHECK ("scope" IN ('class', 'school'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."school_reward_redemptions" (
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "approvedById" text,
  "classId" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "redeemedAt" timestamptz,
  "relatedBookingId" uuid,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "rewardDefinitionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'redemption_requested' NOT NULL,
  "ticketsConsumed" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "school_reward_redemptions_status_check_cfae3676" CHECK ("status" IN ('locked', 'available', 'redemption_requested', 'approved', 'redeemed', 'rejected'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."visit_day_capacities" (
  "bookingCutoffAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "internalNote" text,
  "maxGuests" int4,
  "publicMessage" text,
  "reservedGuests" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "visitDate" date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "visit_day_capacities_status_check_4a07b314" CHECK ("status" IN ('open', 'limited', 'sold_out', 'closed'))
)
